integrity: Analytic full-parameter proof, a standalone standard-library arithmetic verifier, same-model review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two stages, positive output weights, both normalized stage abscissas in [0,1], algebraic stability and order at least three; the coefficient criterion does not imply SSP or practical accuracy.
title: Sharp unavoidable negative Butcher coefficient for two-stage algebraically stable third-order Runge--Kutta rules
